definitions.explanation: An organized set of principles, methods, or doctrines forming a coherent whole.

examples.japanese: {学問|がくもん}の{体系|たいけい}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: I study the system of academic disciplines.

examples.japanese: {体系的|たいけいてき}に{知識|ちしき}を{整理|せいり}する。
この{理論|りろん}は{体系|たいけい}が{整|ととの}っている。
examples.english: This theory has a well-organized structure.

notes:
{体系|たいけい} refers to a coherent, organized system of knowledge or principles.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {体系|たいけい}を{作|つく}る: to create a system
- {体系的|たいけいてき}: systematic
- {思想|しそう}{体系|たいけい}: system of thought
- {知識|ちしき}{体系|たいけい}: body of knowledge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- システム: system (loanword)
- {組織|そしき}: organization
- {体制|たいせい}: system, structure (political/social)
